title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Lantern Hill Cardiology under your Medicaid managed care plan for services provided on July 23, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: Prior authorization was required for the upper GI endoscopy with biopsy and was not obtained before the service was performed. Reason code: CO-197.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $3,995.42 billed. The provider may bill you for this service.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Quillfield Health Plan, Appeals Unit, PO Box 75243, Buffalo, NY 14202. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-4440.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
